headline: Google says its new Gemini 3.8 Flash model ‘works harder’ but might cost more
summary: Google launched Gemini 3.8 Flash, a new AI model, just weeks after its predecessor. The company claims 3.8 Flash "works harder" by performing more reasoning steps and calling tools iteratively. It maintains introductory pricing but could incur higher costs due to increased activity.

headline: Here are some of REI’s best Labor Day sale deals
summary: REI's Labor Day sale offers significant discounts on outdoor gear as summer ends. Shoppers can save on men's and women's clothing, camping, and hiking equipment. The sale includes deals on REI Co-op gear to enhance upcoming outdoor expeditions.

headline: 1Password wades into a right-wing mess after funding a Linux project
summary: 1Password faces customer backlash for a $300,000 pledge to a Linux distro. The distro's creator, David Heinemeier Hansson, has published racist blog posts calling for deportation. The password manager is now a "distinguished corporate patron" of the Omacom project, sparking controversy.

headline: Amazon’s AI assistant can now spot fake emails from the company
summary: Amazon's AI assistant, Alexa for Shopping, now helps combat impersonation scams. Users can ask Alexa to verify if an email, text, or phone call truly came from Amazon. The AI compares messages to determine their authenticity, enhancing security.

headline: The Witcher 4, Cyberpunk 2077 Developer CD Projekt Red Ramps Up Hiring on 'Project Hadar'
summary: CD Projekt Red is significantly increasing its hiring for the unannounced 'Project Hadar'. The development team currently comprises over 30 people. The studio aims to expand the Hadar team to 50 developers by the end of the year.

headline: Over 600 Unused Voice Lines From Resident Evil 4 Leak Online, Showing That Capcom Intended to Connect the Game to Village
summary: Over 30 minutes of unused voice lines from Resident Evil 4 Remake have surfaced online. The leaked audio indicates Capcom's original plan to link the game to Resident Evil Village. The discovery offers new insights into potential cut content and lore connections.

headline: Philips' 65" 4K OLED Roku TV Drops Below $1,000
summary: Philips' 65-inch 4K OLED Roku TV is now available for under $1,000. This significant discount makes high-quality OLED technology more accessible. The deal is offered exclusively at Walmart, providing a premium viewing option.

headline: The Witcher Remake Is on Hold Until The Witcher 4's Development Progresses, Confirms CD Projekt Red
summary: Development on The Witcher remake has been put on hold. CD Projekt Red confirmed that resources are prioritized for The Witcher 4. The studio is also focusing on a new expansion for The Witcher 3.

headline: Burnham pressed on economy at first PMQs as borrowing costs surge
summary: Prime Minister Burnham faced Kemi Badenoch at his inaugural Prime Minister's Questions. He was pressed on the economy amid a surge in borrowing costs. Burnham stated his government is "grounded in fiscal responsibility" to address the challenges.

headline: Faisal Islam: Why bond market wildfire is keeping world leaders up at night
summary: Bond market volatility is causing significant concern among global leaders. Huge AI spending plans are identified as a factor driving up borrowing costs worldwide. The ongoing conflict in Iran is also contributing to the global economic pressure.

headline: King hails 'unprecedented' Bayeux Tapestry exhibition in London
summary: The King has praised the "unprecedented" exhibition of the historic Bayeux Tapestry in London. The culturally significant artwork is on display at the British Museum. British and French leaders are attending the prestigious exhibition.

headline: EU and Nato vow to step up pressure on Russia after 'new escalation' in Germany
summary: The EU and Nato plan to increase pressure on Russia following a "new escalation" in Germany. Berlin attributed a failed drone attack on Leipzig airport to Russia. Russia is being accused of growing increasingly reckless in its international actions.
